m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Your eyes and teeth are so pretty. Do you mind if I keep them?
<ITALICS>With the monster defeated, the Storm Quetzals race out to the open air, relishing their freedom. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>You gently coo at the Storm Quetzals, and they quiet down. As they fly and brush up against you, you feel a static charge. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>Suddenly, one emits a small roar and sparks fly from it to the pillar. All three pillars burst into electric life! </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>A shimmering Prismatic Blade appears on the Dais! </ITALICS>
You prove you have some small ability.
You have been sent to consult with the Oracle to find the Pyramid of the Falling Star?
You are not the only one searching for the Oracle. There are obstacles to overcome in this journey. Your first is Isla Tormenta.
The island was conquered by a Kronosaur, who kidnapped the Storm Quetzals. He cages their power for himself.
Defeat Ahuizotl Drowned Dog. Free the Storm Quetzals he captured, and coax them back to the Storm Pillars.
They will recharge the Storm Pillars, which will summon a Prismatic Blade. Take it, for you will need it later.
Go to Isla Tormenta. Battle Ahuizotl Drowned Dog and free the Storm Quetzals.
Get the Quetzals to charge the Storm Pillars. This will summon a Prismatic Blade, which you should claim.
